notes.title: End of development
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30635094/f2b349091032727c8749f93f5587efeacce19be4.jpg[/img]

Lords and Ladies!

Prime Arena has been an experiment in the new genre for us; based on the universe from another game we’ve made - Prime World. Most of you are familiar with it, and we are sure you spent a lot of hours on the Borderlands of Praya. 

Prime Arena was aimed to deliver new gaming experience in the beloved setting. However, the development vector we chose did not allow the game to fulfill its destination. It was not as interesting to you as we thought it would be, so we froze the development for a while.

We made a thorough analysis of the project and the gaming industry and decided to shunt the development of Prime Arena once and for all in order to concentrate our resources on other projects. To make this farewell as smooth as it can be, we are warning you about the servers shutdown beforehand. You will be able to enjoy Prime Arena for 4 more months.

While the game is still available, we’ve thought that it is a nice idea to forget about the rotations concept and are allowing you to play all the Heroes. Have fun with all the characters in Prime Arena!

[quote][h1]From August 1 2019 game servers will be shut down.[/h1]
And starting with today, March 27 2019, Prime Arena is no longer available for download, meaning that only those who purchased it before March 26 will receive access to the game servers. 
We thank each and every one of you for supporting the project and we hope that 
you had fun playing it. [/quote]

Some players did not only purchase the access to Prima Arena itself (Silver Edition), but also DLCs to it (Gold Edition). To honor your dedication, we want to compensate a part of the funds you spent with Prime World in-game bonuses. 

[quote][h1]Each player who purchased Prime Arena Gold Edition will receive:[/h1]
- Month of Golden Age (premium subscription)
- 3 legendary chests (each one has 3 upgraded talents inside)
- 200 Prime Crystals[/quote]

[h1]In order to receive the compensation, [/h1]
please either: write a letter to account.en@playpw.com with the topic ‘Compensation for Prime Arena Gold Edition’ and state your nicknames in Prime Arena and Prime World correspondingly. If possible, please attach the key you activated the game with to the letter. 

Or create a ticket on Prime World official website using this link: http://support.en.playpw.com/Troubleshooter/Step/View/12

In case you purchased the game in Steam, it is necessary for you to attach a screenshot of your library with Prime Arena tab opened up like so:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30635094/e7d7799a89e94cfdc301002102fa287b3e3366e4.png[/img]

The bonuses will be sent to you within a week.

[i]We have been happy to see you in our game and we hope that you will stay interested in Prime World universe games! [/i]

notes.title: New patch is coming!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30635094/3793f0099cd4e67c5112100f0416d357a46b3aab.jpg[/img]

[h1]Heroes!
Update is active on the game servers.[/h1]

Full list of updates:
[list]

[b]Heroes[/b]
[*]Three heroes are now available to all players at all times: Desperado, Steamrock, and Thunderer. Theese heroes will be available in addition to the weekly rotation.
[*]Fixed various bugs and mistakes in heroes’ ability tooltips.

[b]Map[/b]
Several of the Touched had their abilites redesigned so that they better reflect the effect of the items they drop:
[*]Wholeskin now grows himself a renewable shiled while not taking damage for a period of time.
[*]Scissorhands now blink behind their target dealing a considerable amount of damage.
[*]Sirin birds now passively increas allies’ stats while decreasing enemies’ ones; they also periodically apply Mortal strike on hearby heroes.
[*]Spriggans now create their own fragile copies, enraging should the copies be destroyed.

[b]User Interface [/b]
[*]Added some loading screen tips about opening Map window and the general direction to Anomaly on the minimap.
[*]The Map window now opens automatically upon battle start with your hero position being pinged. Map window then closes automatically when the Touched spawns. You can always open this window using the TAB key.
[*] Added Tutorial button to the lobby screen. It opens a Steam overlay with official Prime Arena guide.
[*]Upon returning to the lobby screen after several battles players will be prompted with an option to share their experience and either rate Prime Arena.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween in Prime Arena!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30635094/d84fa18f06564b72aaab86483c984a20077b090e.jpg[/img]

The Halloween  is coming! 
The Touched in Prime Arena is dressed up to match. The new Hero - Calavera is ready to Día de Muertos. And she will be the  the 6th optional Hero in rotation for the time of the event.

[h1]Halloween`s list of updates:[/h1]
[list]
  [*][b]Heroes[/b]
A new hero has arrived to Prime Arena – Calavera! 
Hero`s abilities:
[i]Inspiration (passive)[/i]
The color of the notes around the hero hints at which ability should be used. Using the indicated ability gets you 25 prime and 1 Inspiration, which stacks up to 20 times.
[i]Battle Song (active) [/i]
Deals 250 damage over 4 sec to 3 nearby enemies. Level 4: also prevents enemies from using abilities for 1 sec. 
[i]Song of Triumph (active) [/i]
On activation, the hero gets 30 to Intellect for 7 sec. Level 7: The hero's attacks under the effect of the Song of Triumph ability reduce enemy's` Speed by 30% for 3 sec.
[i]Song of Defense (active) [/i]
For 3 sec, creates a shield capable of absorbing 280 damage. Level 13: On use, restores 216 Health to the caster. 
[i]Magic Melody (active) [/i]
Level 10: for 7 sec, summons a violin to the selected location that creates a zone of visibility around it and deals 52 damage every second and 29 damage to nearby enemies. Level 16: magic Melody can be used at an increased distance and the summoned violin repeats the Battle Song. 

  [*][b]Map[/b]
All the monsters have hidden in pumpkins and get out only if disturbed. 

  [*][b]Other[/b]
Fixed an issue with repeated consumable drops from Mistress of Souls’s ghosts.
[/list]

notes.title: New patch is coming!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30635094/21263ff092bdd0b046b4359b2c26e5d4882737bc.jpg[/img]

Heroes! The update is active on the game servers.

The full list of updates:

[b]General[/b]

In case of disconnect or game crash player rating will be awarded by the lowest place available instead of current heavy reduction. So if there are four heroes standing and you leave, you'll get 4-th place worth of rating in that particular match.

[b]Heroes[/b]
[list]
 [*]Equalized Speed of all heroes to 57. Except for Steamrock who got only 52.
 [*]Fixed ability descriptions for Freeze, Mistress of Souls, Gunslinger and Da’Ka.
 [*]Fixed an issue with the interaction of ultimate abilities of Fire Maestro and Fang.
 [*]All Native Terrain effects in abilities were either removed or incorporated into the baseline.
[/list]
Mistress of Souls:
[list]
 [*]Damage of the Ghost Whip ability was doubled, but its cooldown was increased from 3 to 7 seconds;
 [*]Cooldown of Shield of Ghosts ability was increased from 9 to 12 seconds;
 [*]Damage and Lifedrain of the Reaping ability were reduced by 25%.
[/list]
Fang:
[list]
 [*]Damage from the Wild Beast ability upgrade is now calculated correctly;
Changed ability upgrade order: Wild Beast at 13-th level and Beast Scent at 7-th;
 [*]Health Regeneration from the Lycanthropy ability was reduced by 15%;
 [*]Strength increase was reduced from 8 to 6 per level.
[/list]

Fire Maestro:
[list]
 [*]Upgraded Wind and Sparks ability now reduces cooldown by 2 seconds instead of 3 per enemy hit;
 [*]The number of empowered attacks from Primeval Fire ability was reduced from 4 to 3; its upgrade now correctly recovers Health to the hero.
[/list]
Veteran:
[list]
 [*]Finishing monsters with Hero Strike ability now correctly awards with consumable items.
[/list]
Naga:
[list]
 [*]Maximum stacks of poison was increased from 3 to 6;
 [*]Fixed a bug with incorrect application of 3 stacks of poison in one attack;
 [*]Fixed a bug that prevented Lifedrain increase from Deadly Dash ability upgrade.
[/list]
Steamrock:
[list]
 [*]Slow from ability Giant Stomp was reduced from 10%-16% to 8%-12%.
[/list]

[b]Map[/b]
[list]
 [*]Glyph nodes, portals, and fountains continue to reveal war fog while they are recharging;
 [*]Grenadiers now root after a certain number of attacks instead of randomly;
 [*]Evil Sparks now are more akin to the Symbol of Shining: they forbid invisibility in an aura and have significant Evasion, but only half of their former Health;
 [*]Models for minibosses and bosses were fixed so that they no longer scale upon spawn;
Killing boss monsters now awards a player with a visible status!
[/list]
[b]Items[/b]
[list]
 [*]Fixed a bug that caused an item icon to appear different from the actual item in that slot;
 [*]Dimension Door item is now disabled while being Rooted as it is a movement ability;
 [*]Fixed a bud that caused a bubble visual effect of Dimension Door and Touched Armor to persist for its full duration even after the corresponding shield capacity was depleted.
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
 [*]Player's name was removed from hero portrait in battle.
[/list]
